name: dropzone
title: Dropzone
description: A wide target for choosing or dropping files.
use: Uploading files where the upload is the main thing in the form: attachments, an import. A click opens the picker, a dropped file lands in the input and the form submits it, all without script.

instead.when: One file in a row of fields; a plain file input shows its own file name
A file that is already chosen or uploaded is shown as a thing with a name

keyboard.action: Open the file picker, as a file input does

classes.name: dropzone
classes.description: The zone, on a label: a well with a dashed contour. It draws the focus ring for its input

classes.name: dropzone-input
classes.description: The file input. It fills the zone invisibly, so files dropped anywhere on the zone are taken

classes.name: dropzone-title
classes.description: What to do, in strong ink

classes.name: dropzone-description
classes.description: The limits a reader must meet, such as types and sizes

states.name: disabled
states.description: The zone drops to disabled ink and stops answering the pointer
